game_title: Trace Table Race – Tavern Quarter Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter, the lively tavern district: the town guard must handle siege rats while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Trace Table Race: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program.
theme: The Kingdom – Tavern Quarter: the lively tavern district
core_gameplay_loop: In Tavern Quarter, repeat each round: Fill a trace table showing each variable after every line of a mini program. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the trace_rows_correct value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the market bell using at most 19 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The market bell reached with actions_used <= 19.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 19 before the market bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 10 (extended tier): Trace Table Race
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Trace Table Race' (Week 1 slot 14), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Tavern Quarter'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how trace_rows_correct changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against siege rats in Tavern Quarter.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The market bell reached with actions_used <= 19.
